item.title: Pulwama Attack Anniversary 2026: Full List of Martyred CRPF Jawans as Nation Observes Black Day
item.description: Today marks the seventh anniversary of the 2019 Pulwama terror attack, one of the deadliest assaults on Indian security forces in recent history. February 14 is observed across the country as Black Day, honouring the supreme sacrifice of 40 brave personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force who lost their lives in the devastating suicide bombing.

item.title: Sreeleela Reintroduces Herself As ‘Dr Sreeleela’ After Graduating With MBBS Degree, Shares Emotional Note (See Pics)
item.description: Many photos and videos from the convocation ceremony at the DY Patil University in Mumbai surfaced on social media. Now, the Tollywood actress Sreeleela has compiled an emotional note on social media, looking back at her long yet fulfilling journey.

item.title: Rare Spot-Bellied Eagle-Owl Spotted in Jim Corbett National Park: ‘Ghost of the Forest’ Captured on Camera in Uttarakhand, Video Surfaces
item.description: A rare and mysterious night bird, the Spot-bellied Eagle-Owl, popularly known as the ‘Ghost of the Forest’, has been spotted in Uttarakhand’s Jim Corbett National Park, sparking excitement among wildlife enthusiasts and nature lovers.

item.title: Malavika Mohanan Shares BTS Clips To Prove She Did Her Stunts Herself Without Body Double in ‘The Raja Saab’ (Watch Videos)
item.description: Actress Malavika Mohanan has moved to silence social media speculation regarding her action sequences in the recently released horror-comedy The Raja Saab. Responding to viral claims that she used a body double for her fight scenes, the actress shared a series of behind-the-scenes (BTS) clips on Friday to prove she performed the stunts herself.

item.title: West Bengal ‘Banglar Yuva Sathi’ Scheme 2026: Know Eligibility and How to Apply
item.description: The Government of West Bengal has announced the launch of the ‘Banglar Yuva Sathi’ scheme, a major welfare initiative aimed at providing financial assistance to unemployed youth across the state. Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee confirmed that applications will open on February 15, 2026, with the scheme set to roll out from April 1, 2026.

item.title: IndiGo Bomb Scare: Shillong-Bound Flight 6E-7304 Receives Bomb Threat at Kolkata Airport (See Pics)
item.description: It was learnt that the IndiGo flight was scheduled to depart from Kolkata for Shillong at 9:15 a.m. But before taking off, the flight attendants found a note in the plane's toilet. It read, 'There is a bomb on the plane'. After that, panic spread among the passengers.

item.title: Heroic Act Caught on Camera: RPF Constable Saves Passenger From Slipping Under Moving Train at Vijayawada Railway Station, Video Goes Viral
item.description: A dramatic rescue at Vijayawada Railway Station has gone viral after an alert RPF constable saved a passenger from a near-fatal accident. The incident occurred on Platform 6 when a man attempting to board the Shalimar East Coast Express with his family suddenly slipped into the gap between the train and the platform.

item.title: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates Emergency Landing Facility on Assam Highway, Lands at ELF on Moran Bypass in Dibrugarh (See Pics and Video)
item.description: Assam witnesses a historic moment as Prime Minister Narendra Modi lands at the Emergency Landing Facility (ELF) on Moran Bypass in Dibrugarh. PM Modi also witnessed an air show by the Indian Air Force (IAF) soon after the ELF was inaugurated. The air show included Rafale, Sukhoi and MIG fighter aircrafts.
